meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: 内容创作者、技术写作员在撰写博客、深度文章或技术文档时，使用此技能可开启全流程写作协作。它能帮你研究资料、构建大纲、逐段打磨并自动添加引用，快速优化Hook，让你高效产出高质量内容，告别孤军奋战！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出带引用、逐段打磨的内容作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总是卡在资料整理和打磨上
copy.tagline_en: Research, structure, and polish articles with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck on research and polishing when writing long articles.

howto.what: 它让 Claude 当你的写作搭档：帮你把想法整理成大纲、查资料并按你指定的格式加引用、优化文章开头；你写一段它点评一段，并尽量沿用你的写作风格。
howto.when: 当你撰写博客、深度文章或技术文档等，或需要做研究、加引用、改进 hook 时触发。

say.text: 帮我为「远程团队协作」这篇文章搭一个大纲
say.note: 它会先问受众、篇幅和风格

say.text: 这是我的开头，帮我改得更有吸引力
say.note: 会给出多个替代版本和理由

say.text: 帮我研究 AI 对产品管理的影响，并加上引用
say.note: 资料和来源会加进你的大纲

howto.what_en: Claude becomes your writing partner: it helps outline, researches topics, adds citations in your chosen format, improves the opening hook, and reviews each section as you write, while keeping your voice.
howto.when_en: Use it when writing blog posts, articles, newsletters or technical docs, or when you need research, citations or a stronger hook.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for an article about remote team collaboration
say_en.note: It asks about audience, length and tone first

say_en.text: Here's my intro - help me make the hook more compelling
say_en.note: You get several alternative hooks with reasons

say_en.text: Research AI's impact on product management and add citations
say_en.note: Findings and sources go into your outline
